lastCompletedStory.title: Mutex failure-mode UX when a 2nd dispatch is attempted with a worker active

nextStoryContext: US-009 complete. All 5 dispatch sites (plan, next, issue, review, ship) now call paneCountMutex(sessionName, tmuxSpawnFn) after the alive/bootstrap check and before sendKeysWhenIdle. If the mutex returns 'busy' (3 panes = worker running), the command prints 'worker busy - blocked until the worker-pane closes' via printError and returns exit code 1. No 4th pane is ever spawned. Each test file's makeFakeTmuxSpawn now handles the #{pane_id} list-panes format (used by paneCountMutex) and accepts a paneMutexBusy option that returns 3 pane IDs when true. Stateful spawn fns in miss-path tests were also updated to handle #{pane_id}. 5 new busy-path unit tests added (one per command). 898 tests pass, 0 fail. Check prd.json for next highest-priority passes=false non-operator story.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-009 is a pure internal change: adds paneCountMutex calls to 5 dispatch sites and updates test helpers. No new external JS library was introduced.
